cascade update-to-expired predicts locally and reaches exact server parity

fixture_isolation: The maintained-column child references aggregateParents rather than the parents table used by direct-action controls. Reference closures are table-level; sharing the parent table would correctly make every parent retirement conservative and would erase the independent direct-prediction controls.

historical_failure.finding: The old web wasm directly predicted aggregate retirement but left groups/g.total at 1 while the server committed 0. R14 instead queues the private-maintain closure and applies the authoritative result during catch-up.
